dct_title_s: Davis County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol AJB; form of individual image numbering: AJB-1-[number], AJB-2-[number], AJB-3-[number], AJB-4-[number], or AJB-5-[number]."Date of completion 11-12-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
